blocs.texte: L'environnement fait face à de nombreuses menaces : la pollution, la déforestation (deforestation) et le changement climatique (climate change) sont parmi les plus graves.

1) Deforestation : la destruction des forêts pour l'agriculture ou le bois. 2) Pollution : air, eau et sol pollués par les industries et les déchets. 3) Global warming : l'augmentation de la température de la Terre, causée par les gaz à effet de serre. 4) Overfishing and hunting : menaçant les espèces menacées (endangered species) et la faune sauvage (wildlife).

In Madagascar, deforestation is a serious problem because many unique animal species, like lemurs, depend on the forest to survive. Pollution from factories and plastic waste also affects rivers and oceans, harming marine life. Climate change causes droughts in some regions, making it difficult for farmers to grow crops.

blocs.enonce: Associe chaque problème environnemental à sa conséquence : 1) deforestation / 2) pollution / 3) climate change A) causes droughts and extreme weather B) destroys animal habitats C) harms rivers, oceans and marine life
blocs.solution: 1-B (deforestation destroys animal habitats). 2-C (pollution harms rivers, oceans and marine life). 3-A (climate change causes droughts and extreme weather).

blocs.texte: Pour décrire un problème environnemental à l'écrit, il faut présenter le problème, ses causes, ses conséquences, et proposer des solutions.

Palm oil is used in many everyday products, such as food, cosmetics and soap. However, palm oil production has a serious environmental impact. To grow palm trees, large areas of tropical forest are cut down, which destroys the natural habitat of many animals, including orangutans. This deforestation also releases a large amount of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, contributing to climate change. To reduce this problem, companies could use sustainable palm oil, which is produced without destroying forests, and consumers could choose products that use less palm oil.

blocs.enonce: En t'inspirant du texte sur l'huile de palme, écris un court paragraphe (5 phrases minimum) décrivant un autre problème environnemental de ton choix (plastique, pêche excessive, pollution de l'air...), en suivant la structure : problème, causes, conséquences, solution.
blocs.solution: Réponse modèle : Plastic pollution is a major environmental problem today. Plastic bags and bottles are used once and then thrown away. This waste often ends up in rivers and oceans, where it harms fish, turtles and birds. Over time, plastic breaks into tiny pieces called microplastics, which pollute the water we drink. To solve this problem, people could use reusable bags and bottles instead of single-use plastic.

blocs.texte: On peut utiliser le conditionnel de type 2 (if clause type 2) pour imaginer des situations hypothétiques liées à l'environnement et leurs conséquences imaginaires.
If + sujet + prétérit, sujet + would + base verbale. Exemple : If people recycled more, there would be less waste.

1) If we planted more trees, the air would be cleaner. 2) If people used less plastic, the oceans would be less polluted. 3) If factories reduced their emissions, climate change would slow down. 4) If everyone recycled their waste, there would be less pollution. 5) If governments protected forests, endangered species would survive. 6) If we used more renewable energy, we would produce less greenhouse gas. 7) If people stopped hunting wild animals, biodiversity would increase. 8) If cities had more green spaces, the air quality would improve. 9) If we wasted less water, there would be enough for everyone.

blocs.enonce: Complète ces phrases hypothétiques sur l'environnement : 1) If people ... (recycle) more, there ... (be) less waste. 2) If we ... (protect) the forests, animals ... (not/lose) their habitat. 3) If everyone ... (use) public transport, there ... (be) less pollution. 4) If factories ... (reduce) their waste, rivers ... (be) cleaner.
blocs.solution: 1) If people recycled more, there would be less waste. 2) If we protected the forests, animals would not lose their habitat. 3) If everyone used public transport, there would be less pollution. 4) If factories reduced their waste, rivers would be cleaner.

blocs.texte: Certains verbes sont toujours suivis d'un verbe en -ing (gerund), jamais de l'infinitif avec 'to'.

Verbes courants suivis du gérondif : enjoy, avoid, suggest, finish, mind, consider, recommend, imagine, practise, keep (on), stop. Exemple : We should avoid wasting water. / She suggested recycling more plastic. / He enjoys protecting the environment.

Albert and Wendy Wedge are two environmental activists who enjoy protecting nature. They avoid using plastic bags and always suggest recycling to their neighbours. Albert recommends planting trees in the local community, while Wendy practises reducing water waste at home. They have finished building a small community garden where they keep on teaching children about the importance of protecting the environment. They imagine creating a cleaner, greener town for future generations.

blocs.enonce: D'après le texte, complète avec le verbe correct au gérondif : 1) Albert and Wendy enjoy ... (protect) nature. 2) They avoid ... (use) plastic bags. 3) Albert recommends ... (plant) trees. 4) Wendy practises ... (reduce) water waste.

blocs.texte: Les adjectifs de personnalité décrivent le caractère d'une personne, ce qui peut aussi influencer son comportement envers l'environnement.

1) An optimistic person believes that environmental problems can be solved. 2) A pessimistic person thinks nothing can be done to stop climate change. 3) A greedy company might cut down forests just to make more money. 4) A patient teacher takes time to explain why recycling is important to her students.

blocs.enonce: Choisis l'adjectif de personnalité qui correspond le mieux à chaque comportement : 1) Someone who always believes things will get better for the environment. 2) Someone who destroys forests only to earn more money, without caring about consequences. 3) Someone who gets angry quickly when people don't recycle. 4) Someone who doesn't try to help the environment because they think it's useless.
blocs.solution: 1) optimistic. 2) greedy. 3) aggressive. 4) pessimistic (or lazy, depending on context).
